verdict.rationale: The axis applies because GST runs a Developer Portal (developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal), so asking whether it ships official SDKs is a fair question. The evidence shows only the portal's Home, Register, Login and Feedback pages, plus taxpayer help modules and a GST Offline Tool for uploading invoices. Nothing documents an official SDK or client library, and a developer portal or offline upload tool is not an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
